# UNS rows (1/4-36, 5/16-36, 3/8-36, 1/2-12, 1-14) are left out: they are
# no standard series. H28/2B prints no major diameter for these tables;
# an internal thread's minimum major diameter is its basic size.
# size tpi series class minor_min minor_max
